correctness.rationale: For fixed \(p<p_{\rm RG}\), the source bound is uniformly of the form \(CTn\exp(-cm^\alpha)\) with \(C,c>0\) depending only on the fixed noise point and uniformly bounded QLDPC degrees. Taking \(T\le n^s\) and \(m=\lceil K(\log n)^{1/\alpha}\rceil\) with \(cK^\alpha>s+r+1\) gives an exponent strictly below \(-r\), so the constant prefactor is absorbed eventually. The logical-dimension, rate, and decoder-time laws then follow from \(N=nm\), \(k=\Theta(n)\), and \(\log N=\log n+O(\log\log n)\). No experiment is used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The source emphasizes universality over the seed code but leaves the resulting family-level spatial tradeoff implicit. The derived regime shows that arbitrary positive-rate seed structure can be retained with only a polylogarithmic loss in rate while achieving polynomially small logical failure for polynomially many rounds, and it simultaneously turns the \(O(\log m)\) decoder into \(O(\log\log N)\) parallel time. This is an operationally meaningful scaling boundary, not an arbitrary substitution or finite numerical slice.
